hints.title: Definition of Good Subsequences
hints.text: A good subsequence has no leading zeros unless the subsequence is the single character "0". Thus, non-zero good subsequences must start with "1".

hints.title: Two Ending Subsequence Counters
hints.text: Maintain ends0 (distinct non-empty subsequences starting with "1" and ending in "0") and ends1 (distinct non-empty subsequences starting with "1" and ending in "1").

hints.title: Linear DP Transitions
hints.text: When encountering "1", it can extend any existing valid subsequence or start a new "1": ends1 = (ends0 + ends1 + 1) % modulo. When encountering "0", it can only extend existing subsequences: ends0 = (ends0 + ends1) % modulo.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking distinct subsequences ending in 0 and 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all subsequences explicitly takes O(2^N) time and space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space accumulator handles distinctness and modulo arithmetic in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should formulate the transitions for distinct subsequences starting with 1 and account for 0 separately.
